description.zh:
容器集群的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~182997~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the container cluster.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~182997~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
目的对象。包含的参数说明如下：

- targetId：目的对象ID，您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数。
- ports：目标端口范围列表。
description.en:
The destination object. The metric description is as follows:

- targetId: the ID of the destination object. You can invoke the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
- ports: the list of destination port ranges.

description.zh:
拦截模式。取值：
- **1**：拦截模式
- **2**：告警模式
- **3**：放行模式
description.en:
The interception mode. Valid values:
- **1**: Block Mode
- **2**: Alert mode
- **3**: Allow mode.

description.zh: 规则的优先级，优先级为1~1000，数字越小优先级越高。
description.en: The priority of the rule. The priority ranges from 1 to 1000. A smaller number indicates a higher priority.

description.zh:
规则的开关状态。取值：

- **1**：表示开启
- **0**：表示关闭
description.en:
The switch status of the rule. Valid values:

- **1**: enabled
- **0**: disabled.

description.zh:
源规则对象。包含的参数说明如下：

- targetId：源对象ID，您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The source rule object. The metric description is as follows:

- targetId: the ID of the source object. You can invoke the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

title.zh: 修改容器主动防御拦截规则
title.en: Modify a container proactive defense interception rule

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-interception-rule --rule-id 500018 --cluster-id c17ef568f81884cdab402decd5fcd0000 --rule-name tetsRule --rule-switch 1 --src-target targetId=400989 --dst-target targetId=600069 ports=["80/8088"] --intercept-type 1 --order-index 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyInterceptionRule --region cn-hangzhou --RuleSwitch 1 --ClusterId c17ef568f81884cdab402decd5fcd0000 --InterceptType 1 --RuleId 500018 --SrcTarget '{"targetId":400989}' --OrderIndex 1 --DstTarget '{"targetId":600069,"ports":["80/8088"]}' --RuleName tetsRule
